thread:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: exp-prompt-route v3 -> canary (5%) at 2026-03-15T17:05:00Z
alice.h: heads up — canary targeting us-west1 only. small shard.
sara.p: ack, preflight metrics look good from the canary test harness.
mike.k: watching latency dashboards (rps steady). I'll keep eyes on error budget.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted: 5% -> exp-prompt-route v3. Logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/deploy/2891239876

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-6123 triggered: elevated 5xx rate on route exp-prompt-route (canary). Severity: P1
ian_oncall: oncall here, taking it. initial glance: 5xx started ~30s after canary flip, spike to 7% errors.

mike.k: seeing stack traces from runtime: NullPointer on kv-cache lookup in prompt-router. repro locally with synthetic trace.
sara.p: on it — can we hit the FF kill? We have a feature flag for exp route.

alice.h: I'm trying the console toggle now. If we flip the flag to stable, traffic should fallback to stable-route v2.
leah_support: FYI support: we already have 3 incoming customer tickets mentioning garbled outputs and timeouts. IDs: INC-891, INC-893, INC-894. Customers A and C are affected.

mike.k: command to flip (internal):
```
curl -X POST 'https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/exp_prompt_route/disable' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d 'actor=alice.h&reason=canary-5xx-spike'
```

alice.h: executed the toggle via console at 17:06:18Z.

deploy-bot: Feature flag exp_prompt_route set to OFF for all traffic. Routing decision should revert within 10s.

ian_oncall: verified traffic metrics — canary baseline traffic 0% after 20s, stable-route receiving all traffic. 5xx dropping back to baseline.
tyler_sre: patch applied to routing layer: added fallback to stable when feature flag disabled. We'll bake a temporary guard for 1 hour.

mike.k: root cause: a race in new routing branch that assumes kv-cache keys exist for certain prefix lengths. Failing for cold-start requests. Patch ready: add nil-check and safe fallback.
sara.p: can we hotfix on canary before re-trying? I'd prefer to test on a staging canary first.

leah_support: support is triaging tickets and sending high-touch replies to impacted accounts. We're recommending retry/refresh for now.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-FF-CUTOFF-2891239876. Severity P1. Customers impacted: 2-5% of requests for the rollout window.

ian_oncall: handing off to tyler_sre for postmortem + remediation tracking. I'll stay until safe handoff is confirmed.
tyler_sre: taking ownership. timeline and next steps: 1) merge safety patch, 2) add automated kill-switch threshold (trigger FF off when 5xx > 2% for 1m), 3) run canary in staging, 4) communicate customers.

mike.k: patch PR: https://git.redwood/routers/pull/452 — tests included.
sara.p: will run a controlled staging canary with synthetic traffic and KV priming.

alice.h: support: please compile list of impacted customers and slas. leah_support?
leah_support: compiling now, will post in #support-escalations and ping CSMs. Draft customer note ready in #templates — waiting for final impact numbers.

mike.k: after FF flip, error rate returned to baseline within ~45s. Estimated affected window: 17:05:30Z — 17:06:18Z. Rough request count impacted ~12k requests across canary.

tyler_sre: created tracking ticket SRE-1287 for automation and rollout guard. Assigned to sara.p and mike.k.
sara.p: ETA for staging canary and verification ~2h. will coordinate with prod infra for a gradual rollout plan.

alice.h: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) add KV priming step to canary job, 2) promote null-check safe path before route experiments, 3) expose FF toggle to oncall dashboard with one-click kill.

leah_support: notified affected customers with initial message and promise of a follow-up. CSMs looped.

ian_oncall: handing off final oncall note — I'm unassigned at 18:30Z but will remain on thread until PMs confirm. please escalate to PD if regression appears.

tyler_sre: closing operational loop for now. will keep thread pinned and post postmortem draft once consolidated.

mike.k: thanks team — good catch on the kill-switch. we'll re-run canary when patch verified.

aleph: (bot) reminder: create postmortem within 72h per policy.

sara.p: acknowledged. I'll open the doc and include monitoring changes and playbook updates.

leah_support: marking support tickets for credit review; will follow up after postmortem.

alice.h: marking thread resolved in channel — reopen if anything new shows up. :white_check_mark:
